name: Olivier Renaud
bio: Olivier Renaud is a Canadian actor native of a Montreal, Quebec. He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from HEC Montreal. Renaud joined the Cirque du Soleil in 2008 and worked as a stage performer/acrobat on the touring show Saltimbanco. He later moved to New York City and then Los Angeles to pursue an acting career. He is now based is Toronto, Ontario.
